{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZfnHzg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDGyBI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 51, "title": "Implement non-mosaic Mode 6 BG1 offset-per-tile addressing", "body": "## Problem

Mode 6 renders ordinary hires BG1 but ignores BG3 offset descriptors. At baseline `5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6`, [`Ppu::bg_source`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/crates/snes-core/src/ppu.rs#L402) admits only Modes 2/4. Its map helper also assigns every hires background a 16-sample width, so merely adding Mode 6 to that condition would leave BG3 descriptor geometry unjustified.

This is the next bounded implementation recommended by the supplied assessment. Ordinary hires was completed in #49/#50; Mode 6 offsets were explicitly excluded. The supplied open-Issue list is empty.

## Expected outcome

Implement non-mosaic, non-interlaced Mode 6 BG1 horizontal and vertical offset-per-tile addressing within the existing scanline renderer. BG3 supplies raw descriptors without becoming a visible layer. Disabled descriptors retain ordinary hires addressing.

The specification contract must distinguish established register semantics from unresolved coordinate derivations:

- Mode 6 combines hires BG1 with Mode 2-style horizontal/vertical offset descriptors. BG1 selection uses descriptor bit 13; the BG2 enable bit must not enable BG1. Horizontal replacement uses the coarse offset field, retaining the affected background’s fine scroll; vertical replacement uses the ten-bit vertical value. Descriptor metadata must not be decoded as character palette, priority or flips. Mode 4’s bit-15 axis selector must not be imported into Mode 6.
- BG3SC supplies descriptor-table base and screen layout. BG3 scroll selects the table independently of the rendered scanline. Derive the horizontal/vertical descriptor locations and BG3-size effects explicitly, including whether the two lookups select the same word.
- Preserve the established ordinary-hires contract: for output sample `j=0..511`, horizontal scroll `H`, vertical scroll `V`, map dimensions `Wm,Hm`, and cell height `T=8 or 16`, disabled offsets yield `sx=(j+2*H) mod (16*Wm)` and `sy=(y+1+V) mod (T*Hm)`. Even samples feed the subscreen and odd samples the mainscreen. BG1 cells remain 16×8 or 16×16, with whole-cell flips and ten-bit character-number wrapping.

Use [Anomie’s Register Doc, revision 1157](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gilligan/snesdev/master/docs/snes_registers.txt), especially BG Scrolling, Modes 2/6, `$2105`, `$210D–14`, and Tile Maps, together with [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm), BGMODE, BG3SC, BG3HOFS/BG3VOFS and BG Map. The repository records source versions, hashes and the resolution of the tentative Mode 6 height annotation in [Issue #49 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/docs/issue-49-validation.md#specification-contract-recorded-before-implementation).

**Specification prerequisite:** the inspected repository does not settle Mode 6’s BG3 coordinate units, descriptor-column geometry, fine-scroll conversion or exact initial unaffected boundary. [Issue #19 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/docs/issue-19-validation.md#specification-attribution) explicitly attributes its `q=x+(HOFS&7)` boundary equation to that Issue rather than an established hardware algorithm. Do not automatically reuse it with half-dot coordinates or treat passing its tests as specification evidence. Reconcile these rules before dependent implementation and publish explicit equations and distinguishing worked examples. If authoritative evidence contradicts the earlier contract, correct the affected implementation, expectations and documentation with a documented derivation. Current evidence establishes uncertainty, not that the previous equation is wrong.

## Context and reproduction

Inspect these existing tests before extending their coverage:

- [`ppu_offset.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/crates/snes-core/tests/ppu_offset.rs): Modes 2/4, fine-scroll boundaries, descriptor layouts, wrapping, large BG3 cells, composition and original CPU guests. It has no Mode 6 cases.
- [`ppu_hires.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/crates/snes-core/tests/ppu_hires.rs): ordinary Mode 5/6 addressing, both output phases, geometry, flips, CPU guests and runner output. These do not establish Mode 6 offset behavior.

Construct an original scene with Mode 6 BG1 enabled on TM/TS, mosaic/math/windows/OBJ disabled, distinguishable source characters, and BG3 descriptors selecting different horizontal and vertical source regions. Compare enabled descriptors with otherwise identical disabled controls. Currently both follow ordinary scrolling because Mode 6 never enters the offset path. Expected pixels must follow the independently reconciled descriptor contract.

Scope is production addressing plus necessary tests and validation documentation. Exclude mosaic, pseudo-hires, interlace, overscan, PAL, raster/fetch timing, memory-port arbitration, hires color-math/window/OBJ accuracy and unrelated frontend changes.

Planning inspected repository files only; no external specifications were retrieved, tests executed or files changed. Specification attribution above uses the repository’s recorded sources.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record the reconciled Mode 6 contract with source sections/version identifiers, coordinate units, descriptor masks, BG3 geometry, H/V lookup locations, first-column eligibility, fine-scroll preservation and wrapping. Include literal descriptor byte addresses and resulting source coordinates at distinguishing boundaries. Identify residual uncertainty honestly; a matching implementation/oracle pair cannot establish disputed hardware behavior.
- [ ] Implement enabled H-only, V-only and combined Mode 6 offsets. Disabled axes retain ordinary scrolling. Keep BG3 descriptor lookup separate from assumptions about visible hires character width wherever their units differ.
- [ ] Add independent original numerical pixel tests, executable with `cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_mode6_offset`. Expected values must use literal vectors or independently constructed coordinate images, without calling production address helpers. Cover both output phases; neither/H/V/both enables; BG2-only enable rejection; ignored descriptor bits; all fine-scroll residues; samples immediately around the reconciled initial and successive column boundaries; BG3 fine/coarse scroll; scanline-independent table selection; both BG1 heights and BG3 size settings; all BG3SC layouts; horizontal/vertical page and table wrapping; 64 KiB VRAM wrap; all character flips; character-number wrap; and output samples 0/1 and 510/511. Include disabled-axis and hidden-layer controls.
- [ ] Add bounded original CPU-executed Mode 6 guests for enabled/disabled horizontal and vertical offsets, including combined offsets and a nonzero fine-scroll case. Initialize registers, VRAM and CGRAM through emulated CPU writes under forced blank; supply no host PPU patches. Assert completion markers, deadlines, 512×224 geometry and literal pixels in both phases. Document source/data licensing and reproducibility in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`; acquire no commercial ROM or firmware.
- [ ] Demonstrate that representative new enabled-offset tests fail against the recorded baseline while disabled controls pass. Preserve existing Mode 2/4 and ordinary Mode 5/6 regression coverage. Change an earlier hardware expectation only with cited contradictory evidence and replacement distinguishing vectors; do not delete coverage or weaken game assertions.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, and the focused `ppu_offset`, `ppu_hires` and new `ppu_mode6_offset` targets.
- [ ] Run the existing source-built CPU/SPC and HDMA gates from [README validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/5230d50c7163c08918b328382e303d879bfa95e6/README.md#validate): build pinned tools with `python3 tools/build-test-tools.py --spc`; run `tools/hardware-tests.py` with the documented ca65/ld65/spcasm paths and `tools/ppu-test.py` with the documented bass path. Preserve licensed source pins, substitutions and numerical assertions. Regenerate and compare the original smoke fixture.
- [ ] Build cleared Castle and Memory twice using the documented commands, preserving their expected hashes. Run `npm --prefix web ci`, `npm --prefix web run build`, install Chromium, and `npm --prefix web test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'` with the documented port override if needed. Retain existing actual Wasm/canvas hires checks, game replays, progression, audio and negative controls without relaxing expectations.
- [ ] Update README and the validation record with actual commands/results, baseline failures, source derivations and remaining limitations. Passing these bounded checks establishes neither full hardware accuracy nor commercial compatibility.

All 24 inventory categories retain their supplied scope and evidence. `cpu`, `bus`, `scheduler`, `dma`, `hdma`, `controllers`, `ppu-bg`, `ppu-offset`, `ppu-hires`, `ppu-mode7`, `ppu-objects`, `ppu-color`, `ppu-ports`, `ppu-display`, `spc`, `ipl`, `dsp-noise`, `dsp-pitch`, `dsp-envelope`, `dsp-echo` and `dsp-timing` remain partial; `dsp-voices` remains implemented_unverified; `ppu-raster` and `pal` remain unimplemented. This Issue adds bounded Mode 6 evidence without completing `ppu-offset`: mosaic/offset interactions and exact fetch/raster behavior remain outstanding. It does not complete Issue #3.

## Optional validation

Additional original source-built scenes exercising longer descriptor sequences. These do not replace mandatory numerical checks.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
